notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Plains that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to look at the top card of a player's library and draw a card at the beginning of the next upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any Plains that enters the battlefield untapped to your hand from the battlefield, returning Mishra's Bauble  from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mishra's Bauble enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a Plains from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
